result: A reusable marketable-quote simulator now feeds normalized, timestamped top-of-book events into the runner outbox. It only fills after configured latency, requires valid two-sided displayed depth, tick-rounds adverse to the trader, caps by visible size, and binds every fill to a stable intent/fill identity and quote-event SHA-256. The runner supplies its immutable decision time, validates the simulation receipt, journals execution before acknowledgement, and retains unknown outcomes until explicit reconciliation.
focused_tests: 91 passed across forward-session crash recovery, runner, clock, Kite, intraday, session-date, book, and paper-execution adapter suites
limitations: Simulation only; no broker order path or observed broker receipt.
Caller must provide current tick metadata and a feed-health gate.
Fees, portfolio accounting, authorized live-market capture, and profitability remain separate work.
